title: Medical image registration
text: Image registration aligns images into a shared coordinate system. Deformable registration permits local shape changes. Dice overlap and Jacobian determinants measure different aspects of registration quality.

title: Coarse to fine curriculum learning
text: Curriculum learning organizes training examples or tasks by difficulty. A multi resolution curriculum can start with coarse image representations and move to finer resolutions. Compare the curriculum with a fixed resolution baseline using ablation studies.

title: BM25 document retrieval
text: BM25 ranks documents using term frequency, inverse document frequency and document length normalization. It is a lexical retrieval method. It does not use vector embeddings or generate natural language answers.

title: Reproducible machine learning evaluation
text: Reproducible experiments record data splits, random seeds, training configuration and evaluation metrics. Ablation studies isolate the contribution of individual components. Small example datasets cannot establish production scale performance.

title: Colour clustering
text: K means clustering groups observations around centroids. Colour clustering can group pixel values to summarize dominant image palettes. Results depend on the selected number of clusters and initialization.
